explanationIssues: The explanation's main rule is Article 120 of the METI technical-standard interpretation (電技解釈第120条): underground electric lines (地中電線路) must use cable. But the attached primary-source pack states that the wiring between the garden lights must not be treated as an Article 120 line (庭園灯間の配線を第120条の電線路と同一視しない). That makes the rule used for ② contradict the source pack. The basis needs to be Article 166 or another applicable clause instead.

The explanation says Article 166 permits cable work for low-voltage outdoor wiring (ケーブル工事を認める). That is only a permission. It does not show that insulated wire (EM-IE) in FEP conduit underground is prohibited. The step from 'EM-IE is not a cable' to 'EM-IE cannot be used' has no supporting clause in the cited sources.
Choice ニ ends with 地中埋設配線には使用できない (cannot be used for underground buried wiring). This also has no clause cited that directly prohibits it. It rests on the same Article 120 reasoning flagged above.
lawNeedsExternalCheck: The source pack for Article 166 (PDF pp. 162–163, para. 1 items 1 and 7, Tables 166-1 and 166-2) only summarises the clause text. Check against the original whether outdoor low-voltage wiring laid underground must be cable, and whether the clause points to Article 120 (e.g. 'shall be installed according to Article 120'). Without that, the claim that EM-IE cannot be used is unconfirmed.

explanationIssues: Choice ロ's explanation says an ammeter-equipped switch needs an A mark to show the ammeter (電流計を表すAの付記が必要). But the source pack says the JIS C 0303 audio PDF (p. 13) does not reproduce the symbol drawings, so the drawing for an ammeter-equipped switch has not been checked. The A-mark requirement is written as fact without support.

Choice ハ's explanation says there is no mark or circuit showing a starter at ⑤ (始動装置を示す傍記や回路は⑤にない). This assumes a JIS symbol for a starter that has not been checked, so the reason for rejecting ハ is unconfirmed.
lawNeedsExternalCheck: Check the actual JIS C 0303:2000 symbol drawings (the original PDF with figures, not the audio version) for: the electromagnetic switch (電磁開閉器), the ammeter-equipped switch (電流計付開閉器, including whether an A mark is added), and the motor starter (始動器). Then confirm the reasons given for choices ロ and ハ.
